newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Second group of firms visits Brazil CVRD Data Room.
newsitem.headline: Second group of firms visits Brazil CVRD Data Room.

text.p: Three more companies are due to view information on soon-to-be-privatized state mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) at Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES), bank officials said Monday.
Japan's Mitsubishi Corp and Nissho Iwai do Brasil and Brazil's Aracruz will be studying the information in the so-called Data Room for 12 days starting today, a BNDES spokesman said.
The BNDES is installing another information room at its headquarters in Rio de Janeiro to accommodate Canada's Noranda Inc, which is also due to view the CVRD documents.

The first three companies to visit the Data Room, Brazil's Votorantim and South Africa's Gencor Ltd and Anglo American Corp, finished studying the material on Saturday. Anglo American has asked for a second viewing in January, the BNDES spokesman said.
Brazil's Companhia Siderurgica Nacional is also scheduled to visit the Data Room in coming weeks, and other companies register.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro Newsroom 5521 507 4151Z
